title: Promote Fable independent audit harness checks into durable tooling
description:
Finding source:
- Fable built an independent scratch harness rather than reusing repo audit code.
- Checks included source->pack all-page shingle coverage, pack->source record/field verification, digit-bearing token consistency, and internal consistency for dice averages, attack bonuses/DCs, class progression, equipment rows, armorClass structures, and concentration/ritual flags.
- Durable copy of the harness code and its output reports is at ~/src/dnd5e-srd-audit-harness-070126/ (lib.py, corpus.py, page_coverage.py, record_check.py, digit_check.py, consistency.py, spell_lists.py, plus page-coverage-report.json, record-check-report.json, digit-check.json, consistency-report.json). The scripts reference the extracted audit bundle at a scratchpad path; point them at an unzipped copy of dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle-070126.zip (BUNDLE constant in lib.py).

Acceptance criteria:
- Review/adapt Fable's independent harness approach into repo tooling.
- Add durable equivalents for high-value checks: page shingle coverage, record-field source verification, digit-bearing token verification, and consistency checks.
- Split into normal CI vs deep pre-freeze audit if runtime is too high.
- Document how to run the deep audit before future freeze/sign-off.
close_reason: PR #395: Fable harness promoted to durable tooling at packages/core/scripts/deep-audit-dnd5e-srd (npm run audit:dnd5e-srd-deep): bidirectional PDF<->pack 6-gram shingle verification (record-check, digit-check, page-coverage with novel-token fail / reordered review split) + pack-internal consistency (dice means, class progression vs table, creature attack bonus/DC vs text, spell dice/save/attack grounding). No parser code shared with importer. Baseline 0 findings across 1812 records/403 pages. CI split: stays out of per-PR CI (verify:dnd5e-srd-pack + tests remain the CI layer); documented as required freeze evidence in docs/deep-audit-dnd5e-srd.md.
